case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

sup:70530.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your quote and for the time your team has put into it.

We commit to a binding volume of 4580 pieces a year over 24 months, our full need for this part, as in our demand forecast (fc:350020@2026-09).
Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Producer prices DE: electronic components (PPI-C2611) changed -2.3% from 2025-01 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2611@2025-01, idx:PPI-C2611@2025-10).

We have set out 3 packages below. Each would be an acceptable basis for agreement for us; if none fits, please tell us which term is the hardest for you:
1. EUR 418.40 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24 months, 4580 pieces a year
2. EUR 412.64 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months, 4580 pieces a year
3. EUR 421.33 per unit, payment 90 days net, 12 months, 3664 pieces a year

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part? And what would you need from us to move further on the price?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70530.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
sup:70530.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your data regarding the PPI-C2611 index and your should-cost estimate, and we have adjusted our calculation accordingly.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €431.67 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

As an alternative, building on your second package, we can offer a unit price of EUR 427.01 in return for the 14-day payment term and the 24-month contract, with a price of €427.01 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

As to the index change and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. That remains. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that our corporate policy does not allow us to share detailed cost breakdowns.

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
